content: Mon fira zorulot

He šomot hozon manuš Isar heṛe hazir oil. Hitara Galilor kissu mainšor babute Isare howa šuru goijje. Hitara hoiye ze, Filate ei Galilor manuššunore haṛi hitarar kurbanir zanuwaror louwor fũwati itarar louwore mišai felaiye.
Zuwabe Isaye hodde,

content.text: "He Galilor mainšor uwore endilla durgoti oiye boli ki hitara dusora Galilor manušottuwaro beši gunagar boli mone goro?
Ãi tũwarare hoir, hen no! Bolke tũwara zodi o mon no firo, tũwara beggune o hendilla dongšo oi zaibagoi.
Ar no oile he aṛarozon, zarar matar uwore Šilo guid bangi fori mori gilgoi. Tũwara ki mone goro, hitara ki ar baki Zeruzalemot bošobaš goredde hitarattuwaro beši gunagar aššil?
Ãi tũwarare hoir, hen no! Bolke tũwara zodi o mon no firo, tũwara beggune o hendilla dongšo oiba."

content: Gula sara ḍũir gasor mesal kahani
Tarfore Isaye ei mesal kahanigan hoiye:

content.text: "Ekzon manuš, hitar ãngur ketit uggwa ḍuirgula gas aššil. Hite heṛe ai ḍuirgula tuwail, kintu no fa.
Henot hite keti sõloyare hodde, 'Ãi eṛe ei gasot tin bosor mula ailam edde ḍuirgula tuwailam, kintu hono gula fa no za. Iba haṛi felaide! Iba eṛe taiyore kiyolla zobin nošto oito!'
"Kintu keti sõloyaye hodde, 'Huzur, ibare ei bosor o raki do, ãi ibar šiyoror sairo ḍakottu kuri fãš diyum.
Zodi gula lage toile to bala, ar no oile hiba haṛi felaiyo.'"

content: Isaye ek mayafuware aram goijje
Ek dórmor din Isaye hono ek sinagogot šikka dil.
Ar so, ekzon maya fuwa, zare aṛaro bosorfan ek bod ruhuye kuza gori raikke. Hiba en behã oi gilgoi hono mote uzu oi no farito.
Isaye zehon hibare deikke, toi hibare hãse ḍaikke, ar hodde:

content.text: "Oh maya fuwa, tui ošukottu azad oiyos!"

content: Hen hoi bade Isaye hãttan hibar uwore raikke. Ar hehon hiba uzu oi tiyai faijje edde hibaye Allar tarif gora šuru goijje.
Kintu Isaye dórmor din aram goijje boli muzolišhanar netaye naraz oiye. Hite manuš okkolore hodde: "So din ase he šob ham goribar. Ar he šomosto din okkolot aiššo edde aram oiyo, dórmor din no!"
Kintu Malik Isaye hitare zuwab diye,

content.text: "Munafek okkol! Tũwara fottizone ki dórmor din tũwarar goru sool okkolore urattu kuli fani habaito no loi zo?
Toile ei maya fuwa, Ibrahimor šontan, zare Šoitane, so, aijja aṛaro bosor dori bandi raikke, he bandottu dórmor din azad fa ki zoruri no ne?"

content: Isaye ei hotabattara zehon hoiye, hibar bifokkor beggune šorminda oiye. Kintu Isar duwara ze šomosto mohimar ham oiye, henot baki šomosto manuš okkol kuši oiye.
Uggwa šoṛo dana edde išor mesal kahani
Tarfore Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Allar raijjo kiyor ḍoilla? Ki loi ãi hiyanor tulona diyum?
Hiyan uggwa šoṛo danar ḍoilla, hono ekzone hiba loi zai nizor baganot lagaiye, bade hiba bari uiṭṭe edde uggwa gas oiye, ar faik okkole he gasor ḍeil okkolot baha bainde."

content: Isaye abar hodde,

content.text: "Ãi ki loi Allar raijjor tulona diyum?
Hiyan išor ḍoil, zin mayafuwainde tin barang moidat maze mišaiye, šeše hin fuli uiṭṭe."

content: Haiṭṭa haṛiwala doroza
Ar Isaye šohore šohore edde fara fara guri guri šikka di di Zeruzalemor uzu giye.
Hetunot ekzone fusar goredde, "Malik, zara uddar far, hitara ki hom manuš?" Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Haiṭṭa haṛiwala doroza bai golibolla har kušiš goro! Kiyollahoile ãi tũwarare hoir, bout kiye butore goilto kušiš goribo, kintu goli no faribo.
Góror malike uṛi zehon doroza bandi felaibo bade tũwara baire tiyai doroza baijjai howa šuru goriba, 'Malik, ãralla dorozagan kuli do!'
"Kintu Malike zuwab di hoibo, 'Ãi no sini tũwara hoṛiyar manuš.'
"Toi tũwara howa šuru goriba, 'Ãra tũwar ekkui fũwati há fiya goijji, ãrare fõte fõte tũi šikka dila.'
"Kintu he malike hoibo, 'ãi tũwarare no sini, tũwara honttu aiššo. Horaf manuš okkol, ãr sarmottu dur oi zogoi!'

"He zagat tũwara handa haṛi goriba edde zala zontronaniye dat loi dat gošiba. Hetunot tũwara dekiba, Ibrahim, Isak edde Yakub edde nobi okkol Allar raijjor butore ase, ar tũwarare baire felai diya oiye.
Ar fuk edde fosimottu, uttor edde doinottu manuš okkol ai Allar raijjot boibo.
Ar so, šešor hataror hono hono manuš foila oibo. Ar foila hataror hono hono manuš šešor hatarot oibo."

content: Isa edde badša Herud
He šomot hoekzon Foroši Isar hãse aišše edde hibare hodde, "Huzur! Õne entu ar oinno hono mikka zogoi, kiyollahoile badša Herude tũware mari felaito sar."
Isaye hodde:

content.text: "Zo, tũwara zai he šiyalore hogoi, 'Aijja edde aiyerde hailla ãi bod ruh dafair edde biyaraimma okkolore aram gorir, ar tin dinor din ãr ham šeš goriyum.'
Zen oibo ok, aijja, aiyerde hailla edde forure šeš gora foribo. Kiyollahoile en to oi no faribo, Zeruzalemor baire hono nobi dongšo o!

"Zeruzalem! Zeruzalem! Tui nobi okkolore kun goros, tor hãse zarare defeṛa o, hitarare fattor mari takos! Faikor maye zendilla hibar so okkolore fakor nise ekkui fũwati gore, ãi hoto bar hendilla tor šontan okkolore ekkui fũwati goitto issa goijji. Kintu tũwara razi no oila.
Hetolla sa, tũwarar gór tũwarar muntu hali fori taibo. Ar ãi tũwarare hoir, tũwara ãre ar deha no faiba zetun foijjonto tũwara no ho, 'Šukuriya ze Mabudor name aišše.'"
